text:
Maya: quick sync request 1: customer PilotCorp asked for tenant-level low-latency routing + prefetch. want to validate launch window in 3w. need cross-team owners for runtime, infra, security, and release gating.

Drew: from product POV we need explicit launch acceptance: p95 <= 200ms on pilot routes, no more than 1.5% eval regressions vs baseline, and clear SLA doc for fallback behavior. also, decide whether pilot is premium-only or open.

Omar: runtime can add per-tenant routing + prefetch hooks. main tradeoffs: warm pool size vs cost, and batch window tuning. need max seq length for prewarm (suggest 512) and an API for tenant config. timeframe: ~5 dev days for API + tests.

Priya: infra: VPC peering + NAT rules + allowlist for PilotCorp IPs = ~8 business days including staging validation. warm pool orchestration requires 2 infra engineers for ~6 days. we should plan staging cut to avoid prod peering work.

Lena: security: KMS + audit logs is the minimal path. HSM adds 3-4w and extra compliance gating. also require key access list + rotation schedule. can fast-track KMS if stakeholders accept.

Drew: proposal for scoping: Phase A = premium routes only, limited seq len, KMS-only. Phase B = broader rollout with HSM if customer pays. keeps timeline tight.

Omar: fallback outline: route to small-model if warm-pool miss or cold-start >200ms. will expose feature flag per-tenant and a "prefer-performance" flag. sample YAML for tenant config I will land in PR: 
```yaml
tenant_prefetch:
  enabled: true
  warm_pool: 15
  max_seq: 512
  fallback_model: "r-small-1"
  prefer_performance: false
```
I'll attach perf baselines to the PR.

Sam: release gating suggestions: canary 3% for 24h -> bump to 20% for 48h if stable. monitors: p95 latency, error rate, cost per request, and eval quality. rollback triggers: p95 +15% vs baseline or eval fails >2% or cost >25% above expected. need dashboards and pager alerts before canary.

Maya: owners: runtime = Omar, infra = Priya, security = Lena, release gating = Sam, product lead = Drew. Action items: Omar PR w/ config + baselines by Thu, Priya infra tickets + staging window by Fri, Lena to confirm KMS rotation plan by Fri, Sam to mock dashboards and alert rules by next Tue.

Drew: quick question 1 to infra: can we provision a small isolated warm pool per-tenant in staging? if not, we should change pilot to a tenant-set that shares pool.

Priya: we can provision isolated pools but it increases infra ops during pilot. prefer shared pool for first pilot and tag customer traffic. i'll note in infra ticket.

Lena: noted on HSM asks 1 - Priya/Drew, flag customers that will require HSM so we can move them to enterprise track early.

Maya: thanks all. scheduling a 30m triage tomorrow 11:00 to confirm timeline and close blockers. will DM any customer IPs. :thumbsup:
